overview_description.description:
Swappaholics offers a swapping site that enables individuals, corporate organizations, and the general public to list, share, and swap various items in Africa. It offers swap deals in various areas such as apparel and clothing, books, vehicles, electronic gadgets, household items, lands and buildings, laptops and accessories, personal items, phones and accessories, software and games, and sports and outdoors.

Swappaholics is based in Accra, Ghana.
